bill.title: An Act amending Title 35 (Health and Safety) of the Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes, providing for Maternal Health Monitoring Pilot Program.

posted_text:
❤️‍🩹 PA SB 965 — PA Could Offer Remote Health Monitoring to Pregnant Women

Pennsylvania is launching a pilot program to improve maternal health.

Starting in 2026, the program will use remote patient monitoring – think connected devices tracking blood pressure and blood sugar – for pregnant women with high blood pressure or diabetes.

The state will partner with managed care organizations and a chosen technology vendor to provide this support, aiming to reach women in areas with limited access to care, like ‘maternity deserts.’ The program will utilize a ‘clinical team’ of nurses and dietitians to guide participants, and establish a system for escalating concerns to healthcare providers.

The state will pay participating managed care organizations up to $600,000 to run the pilot, which will be evaluated over two years.

Oct. 19, 2026: Reported as committed.
